description: Cảnh mới hiện trong lòng một chữ to giữa khung, rồi chữ phóng lớn rất nhanh cho tới khi cảnh mới phủ kín.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-letter, written here): Incoming scene shown only inside one huge heavy letter (or short word) centred on the frame: 0-400 ms the letter mask appears, 400-900 ms the mask scales 1 -> 30 easeInExpo until a stroke covers the frame, then the mask is removed. Align the letter's centre with the next subject. In AE: text layer as track matte. Params: letter (B) · scale (1 → 30) · duration (0.9 s) · ease (expo.in).
